name: md-to-confluence
description: Turn a Markdown runbook, design note or guide into a Confluence page: storage-format XHTML with real code blocks, tables, tasks, info and warning panels, images as attachments and an optional contents macro, a warning for everything dropped, and an optional publish that first shows which page it will create or overwrite and at what version, refuses stale or wrong-space overwrites, and takes credentials only from the environment. Use when the user says "put this in Confluence", "publish this markdown to the wiki", "update the Confluence page with this", "convert to Confluence storage format", or names a Confluence space for a Markdown file.

permissions.notes: Converting makes no network calls. Only --inspect (read-only GET) and --publish (GET, then POST or PUT) contact Confluence, at the https base URL the user passes: a Cloud site under *.atlassian.net, or for Data Center the user's own host, which they must add to the sandbox allowlist themselves. Credentials are read from CONFLUENCE_EMAIL + CONFLUENCE_API_TOKEN or CONFLUENCE_PAT only, never printed; redirects are not followed, so the Authorization header goes nowhere else. Writes only the -o path.

model.rationale: Mechanical conversion to Confluence storage format done by its script, with an optional publish; the model checks what was dropped and what will be overwritten.
